topic: Using Senses to Observe and Describe Objects
key_concepts: Humans use sight, hearing, touch, smell, and taste to observe objects.
Sight can describe color, size, length, and movement.
Touch can describe texture as rough or smooth.
Touch can describe wetness or dryness.
Touch can describe temperature as hot or cold.
Hearing can describe sounds as loud or soft.
Tapping or shaking an object can produce sounds to observe.
Smell can describe an object’s odor as good or bad.
Taste can identify sweet, sour, bitter, or salty flavors.
Some senses are not always safe to use directly, such as smell and taste.
